title: Akamai property configuration
content:
AoA Akamai Admins have read access to property configuration. To look at the current configuraion for www.ikea.com got to Property : www.ikea.com_PropMgr (akamai.com).

Once on property detail page, choose latest version.

On the version page head down to Property configuration settings section and choose “View all “ tab

Search for “add-on-apps rules“ and you will end up in the section with all current configurations for AoAs. Enjoy!
